info.title: Vert.x Authorization Import Test API
info.description: Minimal OpenAPI fixture used by VertxAuthorizationImportIT. Four identical constrained GET operations, each wired with a different IdentityResolutionMiddleware assembly (importer present / absent / failing / hung).

get.summary: Constrained route whose middleware carries a granting authorization importer
Constrained route whose middleware carries no authorization importer
Constrained route whose middleware carries a failing authorization importer
Constrained route whose middleware carries an importer whose provider never completes
